advisory.checklist_item: - [ ] Confirm the absent-mount-point skip in clone_code() is the intended verdict for the deployed box, or gate the return-0 skip on a signal that the mount was never expected (vs failed to mount) so a broken volume does not read as a clean provision.
evidence: infra/scripts/mcp-entrypoint.sh:216: `  if [ ! -d "$code_parent" ]; then`
infra/scripts/mcp-entrypoint.sh:217: `    echo "mcp: code checkout skipped — its mount point ${code_parent} is absent" >&2`
infra/scripts/mcp-entrypoint.sh:218: `    return 0`

The skip verdict answers 'success' both when the host legitimately has no code volume and when the code volume was expected but failed to mount; the two worlds are only separable by reading the announced stderr line, not by the exit status the deployed container's provisioning is judged on.
advisory.finding: clone_code() returns success (return 0) when the code checkout's mount-point parent directory is absent, but REBAR_ROOT is still exported unconditionally pointing at MCP_CODE_DIR. On the box, a volume that was SUPPOSED to mount but failed to (as opposed to a deliberate bare `docker run`) is indistinguishable from the legitimate no-volume case: both hit the same 'mount point absent -> return 0' path, so a genuinely broken deployment is reported as a clean provision while every attested gate silently fails exactly as in the bug being fixed.

advisory.checklist_item: - [ ] Scope the tickets contents:write PAT away from the read-only MCP_CODE_DIR clone/lazy-fetch (e.g. a separate read-only clone URL or a path-scoped credential) so the code mirror does not authenticate with a write credential.
evidence: infra/scripts/mcp-entrypoint.sh:274 `git config --global "credential.${MCP_TICKETS_URL}.helper" ...` (global, URL-scoped to MCP_TICKETS_URL)
infra/scripts/mcp-entrypoint.sh:242-243 `git clone --filter=blob:none --single-branch --branch main "${MCP_TICKETS_URL}" "$code_dir"` — same URL, so the global helper applies

ABSENCE: the comment claims the code clone 'needs NO credential' (mcp-entrypoint.sh:292-293) but nothing scopes the credential helper away from the code checkout's fetches; the global URL-scoped helper covers every operation against that URL including lazy blob fetches
infra/scripts/mcp-entrypoint.sh:186-188 'the snapshot machinery already fetches the objects it needs on demand, so the partial clone is the shape that fits'
infra/scripts/mcp-entrypoint.sh:242 `git clone --filter=blob:none --single-branch --branch main`
ABSENCE: no fallback / offline posture is documented for the case where lazy blob fetch fails at gate time (only the initial clone's soft posture is covered)
advisory.finding: The read-only code checkout is cloned from the SAME URL (MCP_TICKETS_URL) as the tickets store, and the git credential helper is configured `--global` and scoped to that URL, so the blobless clone's lazy blob fetches (and the initial clone) will authenticate using the contents:write tickets PAT — a read-only mirror running with a write-scoped credential, violating least-privilege.
merged_from: The `--filter=blob:none` (blobless) code checkout defers blob retrieval to gate time, making every attested gate a synchronous outbound git fetch to github.com. This converts a one-time boot dependency into a permanent runtime dependency on upstream network reachability and continued anonymous access; if github.com is unreachable or anonymous access is withdrawn, gates fail at request time on an otherwise-healthy container.

advisory.checklist_item: - [ ] Ensure gerrit_mcp_code exists as the EBS-bind external volume before autodeploy's `docker run -v gerrit_mcp_code:...` can auto-create it as a root-disk local volume.
evidence: infra/scripts/autodeploy.sh:394 `-v "gerrit_mcp_code:/var/gerrit/site/mcp-code"`
infra/scripts/compose-up.sh:91-100 volumes are created as `--driver local --opt type=none --opt o=bind --opt device=...` bind onto the EBS host path, and only there
search_files infra/scripts for 'volume create': autodeploy.sh contains no volume-create call — it assumes gerrit_mcp_code already exists
advisory.finding: autodeploy's blue-green `mcp_run_new` references `gerrit_mcp_code` via `docker run -v gerrit_mcp_code:/var/gerrit/site/mcp-code`, which will auto-create a plain local (Docker default root-disk) volume if compose-up.sh has not already created the EBS-bind external volume — silently placing the multi-GB blobless clone off the intended EBS-backed host path.

advisory.checklist_item: - [ ] Add a test that a code checkout with `.git` present but no resolvable HEAD is cleared and re-cloned (--branch main) and emits 'unusable code checkout (no resolvable HEAD) — re-cloning'.
evidence: mcp-entrypoint.sh:259-261 `[ -e "${MCP_CODE_DIR}/.git" ] && echo "mcp: unusable code checkout (no resolvable HEAD) — re-cloning" >&2 ; clone_code`

code_repo_present (lines 195-201) requires BOTH `.git` present AND `git rev-parse --verify HEAD` — the whole point per the commit message ('a container killed mid-clone re-clones rather than being mistaken for converged — the same lesson as fathomable-yester-thrip')

ABSENCE: the tickets store has test_poisoned_store_with_dot_git_but_no_resolvable_head_is_cleared_and_recloned (line 291) but there is no equivalent for the code checkout; test_a_healthy_code_checkout_is_neither_cleared_nor_recloned (line ~544) only covers the healthy skip.

Named violating input: MCP_CODE_DIR containing `.git/HEAD` = 'ref: refs/heads/.invalid' with an unresolvable HEAD (head_resolves=False for the code dir) must produce a --branch main clone AND emit 'unusable code checkout' — currently unverified.
advisory.finding: The newly-added poisoned code-checkout re-clone path is untested: provision_code re-clones and emits 'unusable code checkout (no resolvable HEAD) — re-cloning' when MCP_CODE_DIR/.git exists but HEAD does not resolve, but no test drives a code checkout with a dangling HEAD. Only a HEALTHY code checkout (skip) is covered by test_a_healthy_code_checkout_is_neither_cleared_nor_recloned, so the per-directory presence check (code_repo_present requiring BOTH .git AND a resolvable HEAD) and the clear+re-clone recovery it guards are never exercised.
advisory.suggested_fix: Mirror test_poisoned_store_with_dot_git_but_no_resolvable_head_is_cleared_and_recloned for the code side: create code/.git with a dangling HEAD, run with head_resolves=False, assert run.code_cloned, assert the leftover object was cleared, and assert 'unusable code checkout' in run.stderr.

advisory.checklist_item: - [ ] Add code-checkout serialization tests mirroring the tickets ones (peer holds flock on the code dir inode -> no code clone; peer finishes while waiting -> 'code checkout was cloned by another container', no redundant clone).
evidence: mcp-entrypoint.sh:228-239 `exec 8<"$code_dir" ; flock -w "$MCP_RECLONE_LOCK_WAIT" 8 ...` and the double-checked `code_repo_present` re-probe emitting 'code checkout was cloned by another container'
ABSENCE: no test acquires a peer flock on the code directory's inode; _peer_lock_fd is only ever pointed at the tracker directory (line 484, 521).
advisory.finding: The code checkout's new inode flock on a SEPARATE fd (fd 8, 'so the two cannot alias' per the commit) has no serialization test, unlike the tickets store which has test_a_concurrent_reclone_is_not_interleaved and test_a_peer_finishing_the_clone_while_we_wait_skips_the_redundant_reclone.

evidence: src/rebar/_config_resolvers.py:394 `env_root = os.environ.get("REBAR_ROOT")` in resolve_run_root (scratch base)
src/rebar/config.py:530 `reconciler_repo_root` reads REBAR_ROOT
src/rebar/_config_resolvers.py:250 repo_root reads REBAR_ROOT with precedence env>git
infra/scripts/mcp-entrypoint.sh:190 comment: 'runs in the BACKGROUND ... allowed to outlive the 120s ... readiness deadline' — REBAR_ROOT is set before the checkout exists
advisory.finding: REBAR_ROOT is the single global repo-root override consumed by many rebar code paths (repo_root, resolve_run_root's workflow scratch base, reconciler_repo_root), not only the attested gates' object-DB lookup. Repointing it at /var/gerrit/site/mcp-code changes root resolution for the whole MCP server process; until the backgrounded clone converges (and permanently in the no-PAT / absent-mount skip cases) this directory is empty, so any non-attested read/write path that resolves repo_root against it now sees an empty non-git dir rather than the prior /app.

evidence: Dockerfile.mcp:89-91 `ENV REBAR_TRACKER_DIR=... MCP_CODE_DIR=/var/gerrit/site/mcp-code REBAR_ROOT=/var/gerrit/site/mcp-code`
docker-compose.yml:375-376 `MCP_CODE_DIR: "/var/gerrit/site/mcp-code"` / `REBAR_ROOT: "/var/gerrit/site/mcp-code"`
autodeploy.sh:387-388 `-e "MCP_CODE_DIR=/var/gerrit/site/mcp-code"` / `-e "REBAR_ROOT=/var/gerrit/site/mcp-code"`
docker-compose.yml:374 comment `MUST stay at parity with mcp_run_new in infra/scripts/autodeploy.sh` names only autodeploy, not the Dockerfile ENV
advisory.finding: MCP_CODE_DIR and REBAR_ROOT are declared in three independent locations — Dockerfile.mcp ENV, docker-compose.yml service env, and autodeploy.sh mcp_run_new — but the documented compose-parity guard only pins compose against autodeploy, leaving the Dockerfile ENV copy free to drift out of sync.
